problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Component Alpha: weight 38 tons
* Component Beta: weight 66 tons
* Component Gamma: weight 63 tons
* Component Delta: weight 70 tons
* Component Epsilon: weight 43 tons
* Component Zeta: weight 64 tons
* Component Eta: weight 36 tons
* Component Theta: weight 56 tons
* Component Iota: weight 70 tons
* Component Kappa: weight 64 tons
* Component Lambda: weight 55 tons
* Component Mu: weight 47 tons
* Component Nu: weight 48 tons
* Component Xi: weight 58 tons
* Component Omicron: weight 53 tons
* Component Pi: weight 66 tons

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total weight on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
